title: TrumpFile Reports Two 2016 Airport Overlaps Between Trump Campaign and Rybolovlev Jets
description_short: TrumpFile reported two 2016 airport overlaps between a Trump campaign jet and Dmitry Rybolovlev’s aircraft; it says both men claimed they had never met.
description_medium: TrumpFile’s November 3, 2016 post said the Trump campaign’s jet and Dmitry Rybolovlev’s aircraft landed at the same airports in Las Vegas and Charlotte around the same time on October 30 and November 3. It said Trump was campaigning and that both men claimed they had never met. The account reports aircraft proximity, not a meeting or confirmed passenger overlap.
description_long: TrumpFile’s post, titled “Donald Trump and Dmitry Rybolovlev cross paths twice in a week,” reported two airport overlaps between the Trump campaign’s jet and an aircraft associated with Dmitry Rybolovlev. It said the planes landed at the same airports in Las Vegas and Charlotte, North Carolina, around the same time on October 30 and November 3, while Trump was campaigning. The post added that the aircraft shared the Charlotte tarmac for several hours before Trump left for a rally near Raleigh, and that a Rybolovlev spokesman declined to explain the Charlotte visit. It also said both men claimed they had never met and described whether the flights enabled contact as unresolved. This account supports a report of aircraft proximity on two occasions. It does not establish who was aboard, whether Trump and Rybolovlev were personally at either airport at the same time, whether they met or communicated, or whether the travel was coordinated.
